items.q: He was playing with George up there at the California Club. We used to go by there and sit in with them sometimes.

ctx.x: And, oh, I met Bernie Peters, the fantastic drummer from San Francisco. He was playing with George up there at the California Club. We used to go by there and sit in with them sometimes.
But anyway, the Backstage was really happening.
